title: Re-Disclosure Cushion on Loan Estimate Costs, Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit
content:
Because costs on a Loan Estimate can still rise, a re-disclosure cushion is added to the costs a Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit can still pay, together with the other terms of those costs, before the floor at zero. The cushion is read from the days between the date the reduction is booked and the signing date scheduled with the settlement agent under the borrower's Closing and Funding engagement, and from the status of the borrower's Mortgage Loan File.

| Scheduled signing date, counted in calendar days from the booking date | Loan file status | Re-disclosure cushion |
|---|---|---|
| more than 60 days away | not yet clear to close | 5 percent of the payable closing costs, rounded to the cent |
| 31 to 60 days away | not yet clear to close | 2.5 percent of the payable closing costs, rounded to the cent |
| any other case, including no scheduled signing | — | none |

**Clause.** More than 60 days away on a file not yet clear to close adds 5 percent of the payable closing costs, rounded to the cent; 31 to 60 days away on a file not yet clear to close adds 2.5 percent of them, rounded to the cent; any other case, including no scheduled signing, adds no cushion.

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical payable closing costs of 5000.00, file in underwriting)

| Days to the scheduled signing | Cushion |
|---|---|
| 61 | 250.00 |
| 60 | 125.00 |
| 31 | 125.00 |
| 30 | none |

A file already clear to close takes no cushion at any distance, and so does a file with no signing scheduled.

The cushion is rounded to the cent on its own, before it is added: with hypothetical payable closing costs of 4321.30 and a signing 45 days away, 2.5 percent is 108.0325, and the cushion added is 108.03.
